description:
**One mistake fossil can report**, identified by its code.

Serialized as `{ "code": "area/kind", "data": { … } }`: the code is the serde tag, and `data` is always an object. `Display` is the message for a person, rendered from the data; nothing should parse it — a value a host needs is a field.

oneOf.description: The parser wanted one token and found another. Both are token kinds.
oneOf.title: Expected another token
oneOf.x-detail: "expected {expected}, found {found}"

oneOf.description: A token the parser skipped while recovering from an earlier mistake.
oneOf.title: Unexpected token
oneOf.x-detail: "unexpected token"

oneOf.description: A character no token of the language starts with.
oneOf.title: No token starts with this character
oneOf.x-detail: "unexpected character `{character}` — no token starts with it"

oneOf.description: A spelling the language had and retired, recognised on purpose so the message can name what replaces it.
oneOf.title: A retired spelling
oneOf.x-detail: "`{spelling}` is retired: write `{replacement}`"

oneOf.description: A `@rename` written incompletely; `missing` is the part it lacks.
oneOf.title: A malformed rename
oneOf.x-detail:
"this `@rename` has no {missing}: a rename is \
         `@rename(Type, \"<predicate IRI>\" as <name>)`"

oneOf.description: An attribute written where it does not belong.
oneOf.title: An attribute in the wrong place
oneOf.x-detail: "`{attribute}` does not belong {place}"

oneOf.description: A mapping whose header cannot be read; nothing is produced from it.
oneOf.title: Not a mapping header
oneOf.x-detail:
"this is not a mapping header — {reason} — so nothing is produced from it. A mapping is \
         `Name : Shape from <source>`"

oneOf.description: A property whose left-hand side is not a bare name; `name` is absent when there is nothing on the left at all.
oneOf.title: Not a property name
oneOf.x-detail: "{}", property_name(.name.as_deref())

oneOf.description: A number literal that does not fit the type it is read as.
oneOf.title: A number fossil cannot carry
oneOf.x-detail: "`{literal}` does not fit in {kind}: {reason}"

oneOf.description: A `? :` missing one of its three parts.
oneOf.title: An incomplete conditional
oneOf.x-detail:
"`{expression}` is not a complete conditional: it needs a condition, a `?` branch and \
         a `:` branch"

oneOf.description: A function named where a value belongs and never called.
oneOf.title: A function named and not called
oneOf.x-detail: "`{function}` names a function but does not call it; fossil has no function values"

oneOf.description: A member written in quotes that is already an identifier. Each name has one spelling, and `name` is written bare.
oneOf.title: Quotes around an identifier
oneOf.x-detail: "`\"{name}\"` is an identifier, so it is written bare: `.{name}`"

oneOf.description: A quoted member with an interpolation hole. A member's name is a constant.
oneOf.title: A hole in a member's name
oneOf.x-detail: "a quoted member names a column, and a name is a constant: it cannot interpolate"

oneOf.description: A call whose callee is not a name.
oneOf.title: Not a function name
oneOf.x-detail: "`{callee}` calls something that is not a function name; only a catalogued name may be called"

oneOf.description: A shape name no `type { … } := …` binding introduces. `declared` is the names the program does bind.
oneOf.title: Not a shape this program declares
oneOf.x-detail: "`{shape}` is not a shape this program declares"

oneOf.description: A property key the target shape does not declare.
oneOf.title: Not a property the shape declares
oneOf.x-detail: "{}", unknown_property(.property, .declared)

oneOf.description: A column a row does not have. `fields` is what it does have.
oneOf.title: Not a field of this row
oneOf.x-detail: "`{field}` is not a field of `{relation}`"

oneOf.description: A qualified reference to a row that is not in scope where it is written — a mapping's, a pipeline stage's or a join's. `rows` is what is in scope.
oneOf.title: A row that is not in scope
oneOf.x-detail:
"`{binding}.{column}` reads a row `{scope}` does not have — it has {}",
code_list(.rows)

oneOf.description: A dotted run under a row binding, `Knows.Person.id`. A row's columns have no members, so it is read as a column whose name has a dot in it; `quoted` is how that column is written.
oneOf.title: A dotted name read as a column
oneOf.x-detail:
"`{reference}` reads a member of a column, and a row's columns have none — a column whose \
         name has a dot in it is written quoted: `{quoted}`"

oneOf.description: A call to a name the catalogue does not have. `unknown_namespace` is set when the part before the dot is itself unknown.
oneOf.title: Not a function fossil knows
oneOf.x-detail: "{}", unknown_function(.function, .unknown_namespace.as_deref())

oneOf.description: A named argument no parameter of the function has.
oneOf.title: Not a parameter of this function
oneOf.x-detail:
"`{function}` has no parameter called `{parameter}` — it takes {}",
code_list(.parameters)

oneOf.description: A `from` that names no source binding. `bound_to` is the constructor the name is bound to instead, when it is bound at all.
oneOf.title: Not a source binding
oneOf.x-detail: "{}", unknown_source(.binding, .bound_to.as_deref())

oneOf.description: A call given fewer arguments than it requires or more than it takes.
oneOf.title: The wrong number of arguments
oneOf.x-detail: "{}", arity(.function, .min, .max, .given)

oneOf.description: A parameter given twice — named twice, or named when the receiver already fills it.
oneOf.title: An argument given twice
oneOf.x-detail: "{}", duplicate(.function, .parameter, .receiver)

oneOf.description: A parameter left empty with a later one given.
oneOf.title: A parameter skipped
oneOf.x-detail:
"`{function}` is given nothing for `{parameter}`, and something after it; a parameter \
         cannot be skipped"

oneOf.description: A positional argument after a named one.
oneOf.title: A positional argument after a named one
oneOf.x-detail:
"`{argument}` is positional and follows `{named} = …`; once an argument is named, the \
         ones after it are too"

oneOf.description: A named argument to an edge, whose arguments are positional.
oneOf.title: A named argument to an edge
oneOf.x-detail:
"`{argument}` names an argument of `{target}`, and an edge's arguments fill its \
         identity template in the order they are written"

oneOf.description: A source alias given to a call that takes values.
oneOf.title: A source alias in a value call
oneOf.x-detail: "`{alias}` is a source alias, and `{function}` takes values; an alias belongs to a join over rows"

oneOf.description: A property written with a value of a type its shape does not allow.
oneOf.title: A property of the wrong type
oneOf.x-detail: "`{property}` expects {expected}, and this is {actual}"

oneOf.description: An argument of a type its parameter does not take. `position` is 1-based, and absent for the receiver of a member call.
oneOf.title: An argument of the wrong type
oneOf.x-detail: "{}", argument_mismatch(.function, .position.as_ref(), .expected, .actual)

oneOf.description: A relation written where a value belongs.
oneOf.title: A relation where a value belongs
oneOf.x-detail: "`{function}` gives back a relation, which is not a value"

oneOf.description: A value that has to be Bool and is not. `operand` says which.
oneOf.title: Not a Bool
oneOf.x-detail: "{operand} must be Bool, and it is {actual}"

oneOf.description: A value that has to be a number and is not. `operand` says which.
oneOf.title: Not a number
oneOf.x-detail: "{operand} must be a number, and it is {actual}"

oneOf.description: A comparison between two types that do not compare.
oneOf.title: Values that cannot be compared
oneOf.x-detail: "cannot compare {left} with {right} using `{operator}`"

oneOf.description: A `? :` whose branches have different types; fossil does not coerce.
oneOf.title: Branches of different types
oneOf.x-detail: "the branches of `? :` have different types: {then} and {otherwise}"

oneOf.description: No shape document where one is needed. `binding` is the binding that names none; absent when the program names none at all.
oneOf.title: No shape document
oneOf.x-detail: "{}", no_document(.binding.as_deref())

oneOf.description: Two predicates of one shape whose short names coincide, which makes both unwritable. `first` and `second` are their IRIs.
oneOf.title: Two predicates share a name
oneOf.x-detail: "two predicates of {shape} are both called `{name}`"

oneOf.description: A predicate the shape requires and the mapping never writes.
oneOf.title: A required property is never written
oneOf.x-detail: "`{mapping}` never writes `{property}`, and {shape} requires it"

oneOf.description: A value disjunction in a shape, which one mapping cannot write.
oneOf.title: A value disjunction
oneOf.x-detail: "a value disjunction is not supported: shape `{shape}` has {branches} branches"

oneOf.description: A shape graph that refers back to itself.
oneOf.title: A cyclic shape reference
oneOf.x-detail: "cyclic shape graph not supported: {}", .path.join(" -> ")

oneOf.description: A shape reference the document does not resolve.
oneOf.title: An unresolved shape reference
oneOf.x-detail: "unresolved shape reference `{reference}` in shape `{shape}`"

oneOf.description: A binding that names more shapes than its document declares; names bind by position, and `position` is the surplus name's.
oneOf.title: More names than shapes
oneOf.x-detail:
"the binding names {named} shape(s) and the document declares {declared}, so `{name}`, \
         at position {position}, binds nothing"

oneOf.description: A `@rename` naming a type its binding does not introduce.
oneOf.title: A rename of a type the binding does not introduce
oneOf.x-detail: "`@rename` names `{shape}`, which this `type` binding does not introduce"

oneOf.description: A `@rename` naming a predicate its shape does not declare.
oneOf.title: A rename of a predicate the shape does not declare
oneOf.x-detail: "`{shape}` declares no predicate `{predicate}`, so this rename never fires"

oneOf.description: A program whose sources declare two different output shapes; one program writes one.
oneOf.title: More than one output shape
oneOf.x-detail: "a program may declare only one output shape; found `{first}` and `{second}`"

oneOf.description: A document the program names that nothing is registered under.
oneOf.title: A document is not registered
oneOf.x-detail: "the document `{document}` is not registered"

oneOf.description: A registered document its provider could not decode. `reason` is the decoder's own account, when it gave one.
oneOf.title: A document does not parse
oneOf.x-detail: "{}", unparseable(.document, .reason.as_deref())

oneOf.description: Documents a run needed that the host could not read.
oneOf.title: Documents could not be read
oneOf.x-detail:
"{} document(s) could not be read: {}", .documents.len(),
.documents.join(", ")

oneOf.description: A constructor no installed provider answers to.
oneOf.title: Not a provider this host installs
oneOf.x-detail: "`{constructor}` is not a provider this host installs"

oneOf.description: A provider asked for something it does not do — types of a row reader.
oneOf.title: The provider cannot do this
oneOf.x-detail: "`{constructor}` does not {capability}"

oneOf.description: A document whose extension the provider does not read.
oneOf.title: The provider does not read this extension
oneOf.x-detail: "`{constructor}` does not read `{document}`"

oneOf.description: A document written as a bare path, with no provider to read it.
oneOf.title: A document path with no provider
oneOf.x-detail: "`{document}` is named by no provider"

oneOf.description: A reader option whose value no reader can be given: not a string (`value` absent), or not one ASCII character.
oneOf.title: A reader option fossil cannot pass on
oneOf.x-detail: "{}", invalid_reader_option(.option, .constructor, .value.as_deref())

oneOf.description: A reader option the provider does not have; `owner` is the one that does.
oneOf.title: A reader option of another provider
oneOf.x-detail: "`{constructor}` has no `{option}`; `{owner}` does"

oneOf.description: A mapping with no `@subject`.
oneOf.title: A mapping with no identity
oneOf.x-detail: "`{mapping}` declares no `@subject`, so the rows it writes have no identity"

oneOf.description: A mapping with two `@subject` lines.
oneOf.title: Two identities in one mapping
oneOf.x-detail: "`{mapping}` declares `@subject` twice, and a type has one identity"

oneOf.description: A `@subject` that is not the first line of its body. `line` is 1-based, within the body.
oneOf.title: The identity is not first
oneOf.x-detail: "`@subject` is the first line of a mapping body, and in `{mapping}` it is line {line}"

oneOf.description: Two mappings producing one type with two different `@subject` forms.
oneOf.title: Two identities for one type
oneOf.x-detail: "`{first}` and `{second}` mint two identities for {shape}"

oneOf.description: An edge to a type no mapping writes, so there is no identity to build.
oneOf.title: An edge to a type nothing writes
oneOf.x-detail:
"no mapping in this program writes a `{target}`, so `{target}(…)` has no identity \
         template to build from"

oneOf.description: An edge given a number of values its identity template has no holes for. `mapping` is the one whose `@subject` declares the template.
oneOf.title: An edge given the wrong number of values
oneOf.x-detail:
"`{target}` is built from {takes} value(s) and this passes {given}; its identity is \
         declared by `{mapping}`"

oneOf.description: A stage whose verb the catalogue does not have.
oneOf.title: Not a relation verb
oneOf.x-detail: "`{verb}` is not a relation verb; the catalogue has {}", code_list(.verbs)

oneOf.description: A verb the catalogue declares and the lowering does not implement yet.
oneOf.title: A verb with no lowering yet
oneOf.x-detail:
"`{verb}` is a relation verb the lowering does not implement yet, so `{pipeline}` \
         cannot compile; implemented today: {}",
code_list(.implemented)

oneOf.description: A stage missing a position it needs (`missing`), or given more than it takes (`missing` absent).
oneOf.title: A stage given the wrong arguments
oneOf.x-detail: "{}", stage_arity(.verb, .pipeline, .missing.as_deref())

oneOf.description: A stage argument of the wrong kind — a value where a column or a binding name belongs.
oneOf.title: A stage argument of the wrong kind
oneOf.x-detail: "`{parameter}` in `{pipeline}` takes {expected}, and this is not one"

oneOf.description: A `group_by` output that is not an aggregate call. `function` is the call written, when it is a call; `aggregates` are the ones there are.
oneOf.title: Not an aggregation
oneOf.x-detail: "{}", not_an_aggregate(.name, .pipeline, .function.as_deref())

oneOf.description: An alias on a `union`, whose result has the pipeline's one name.
oneOf.title: An alias on a union
oneOf.x-detail:
"`union` in `{pipeline}` gives its result the one name `{pipeline}`, so the alias \
         `{alias}` would name a row it does not produce"

oneOf.description: A pipeline that derives from itself.
oneOf.title: A pipeline that derives from itself
oneOf.x-detail:
"the source pipeline `{pipeline}` derives from itself, directly or through the \
         pipelines it names"

oneOf.description: A `join` whose other side declares no schema, so its condition cannot be checked.
oneOf.title: A join over a source with no schema
oneOf.x-detail:
"`join` in `{pipeline}` joins {}, whose columns are unknown: it declares no schema, so \
         there is nothing to check the condition against",
code_list(.bindings)

oneOf.description: A `union` whose two sides carry different rows. Each column is `name: Type`; `column` is the 1-based first that differs, absent when the counts do.
oneOf.title: Union sides with different rows
oneOf.x-detail: "{}", union_mismatch(.pipeline, .left, .right, .column.as_ref())

oneOf.description: A `join` condition that is not an equality, or a conjunction of them.
oneOf.title: A join condition that is not an equality
oneOf.x-detail: "`join` in `{pipeline}` relates its two sides by equality, and `{condition}` is not one"

oneOf.description: A `join` key that is not a column reference.
oneOf.title: A join key that is not a column
oneOf.x-detail:
"`join` in `{pipeline}` equates `{left}` with `{right}`, and `{operand}` is not a column \
         reference"

oneOf.description: A `join` equality whose two columns are on the same side.
oneOf.title: A join condition on one side only
oneOf.x-detail: "`join` in `{pipeline}` equates `{left}` with `{right}`, and both are columns of the {side} side"

oneOf.description: An expression or literal the parser reads and the lowering has no case for — a gap in the compiler, not a mistake in the program.
oneOf.title: An expression fossil cannot lower yet
oneOf.x-detail: "`{expression}` is not an expression fossil can lower yet, so this property is not written"

oneOf.description: An operator asked for more memory than the run's budget had left. Raised while the graph executes, before any byte of the corpus is written. Sizes are bytes.
oneOf.title: The run needs more memory than its budget
oneOf.x-detail:
"the run needs more memory than the executor's {:.0} MiB budget: {consumer} asked for \
         {:.1} MiB with {:.1} MiB already held. Nothing was written.",
mib(.budget), mib(.requested), mib(.reserved)

oneOf.description: A run over a program that does not compile. The failure's `related` carries the program's diagnostics.
oneOf.title: The program does not compile
oneOf.x-detail: "the program does not compile; nothing was run"

oneOf.description: The destination a run writes under is not a prefix any store covers.
oneOf.title: No store covers the destination
oneOf.x-detail: "no store covers the destination {destination}"

oneOf.description: A CSV, JSON or Parquet source names no file in its store.
oneOf.title: A source names no file
oneOf.x-detail: "the source `{locator}` names no file"

oneOf.description: A source's bytes are not UTF-8 text.
oneOf.title: A source is not UTF-8
oneOf.x-detail: "the source `{locator}` is not UTF-8"

oneOf.description: A source's bytes did not parse in the format the program named.
oneOf.title: A source does not parse
oneOf.x-detail: "the source `{locator}` does not parse"

oneOf.description: The query engine failed; its own error is the cause.
oneOf.title: The query engine failed
oneOf.x-detail: "the query engine failed"

oneOf.description: Writing one file of the corpus failed; the store's error is the cause.
oneOf.title: A corpus file could not be written
oneOf.x-detail: "`{path}` could not be written"

oneOf.description: More vertices than a `u32` `dense_id` can number.
oneOf.title: The graph has too many vertices
oneOf.x-detail: "the graph has {vertices} vertices; a `dense_id` is a u32"

oneOf.description: The host vended no credential for a scope.
oneOf.title: No credential was vended
oneOf.x-detail: "the host vended no {access} credential for {scope}"

oneOf.description: A scope whose credentials cover more than the one prefix a reader needs.
oneOf.title: More than one prefix was vended
oneOf.x-detail: "{scope} vends {count} prefixes, and one was expected"

oneOf.description: A locator outside every prefix a credential was vended for.
oneOf.title: Outside the vended prefix
oneOf.x-detail: "{locator} lies outside {prefix}"

oneOf.description: A vended credential fossil cannot read: a missing or malformed key, or a prefix that is not a directory.
oneOf.title: A credential is malformed
oneOf.x-detail: "the credential for {prefix} is malformed: `{key}` {reason}"

oneOf.description: A locator no kind of store fossil reads can route.
oneOf.title: No store routes this locator
oneOf.x-detail:
"{locator} has no route: fossil reads s3://bucket/… and \
         abfss://container@account.dfs.core.windows.net/… through a vended credential, and \
         http(s) without one"

oneOf.description: A store answered with an error; the store's error is the cause.
oneOf.title: A store could not be reached
oneOf.x-detail: "{locator} could not be reached"

oneOf.description: The engine a host handed over cannot read remote storage.
oneOf.title: The engine cannot read remote storage
oneOf.x-detail: "the engine cannot read remote storage: its httpfs extension is not loaded"

oneOf.description: The host refused a request for credentials; its rejection is the cause.
oneOf.title: The host refused
oneOf.x-detail: "the host refused {scope}"

oneOf.description: The host did not answer a request for credentials or connections within the deadline fossil holds every host wait to; `after` is that deadline, in milliseconds.
oneOf.title: The host did not answer
oneOf.x-detail: "the host did not answer {scope} within {after} ms"

oneOf.description: A wasm module that could not be fetched — refused, missing, or not there within the boot deadline; `after` is that deadline, in milliseconds, when it is what ended the wait. The browser's error is the cause.
oneOf.title: A module could not be loaded
oneOf.x-detail: "{locator} could not be loaded"

oneOf.description: A corpus whose manifest could not be read; the reader's error is the cause.
oneOf.title: The corpus could not be read
oneOf.x-detail: "{path} could not be read"

oneOf.description: A manifest that is not JSON.
oneOf.title: The manifest is not JSON
oneOf.x-detail: "{path} is not JSON"

oneOf.description: A manifest declaring a format this reader does not read.
oneOf.title: The corpus format is not supported
oneOf.x-detail: "{path} declares format {format}, and this reader reads fossil/1 only"

oneOf.description: A manifest declaring one table twice.
oneOf.title: A table is declared twice
oneOf.x-detail: "the corpus declares {table} twice"

oneOf.description: A corpus location carrying a query or a fragment. A corpus is a prefix and every file is named under it; a query string — a signature among them — addresses one object and does not survive the join. Signed storage is reached by opening a job under the host that vends it.
oneOf.title: Not a corpus location
oneOf.x-detail:
"{location} carries a query or a fragment, and a corpus location is a prefix: signed \
         storage is opened as a job, under the host that vends its credential"

oneOf.description: An argument a caller passed that is not what the call takes.
oneOf.title: An argument is invalid
oneOf.x-detail: "`{argument}` is not {expected}"

oneOf.description: A call made while another call on the same object is still running.
oneOf.title: Another call is running
oneOf.x-detail: "`{call}` was called while another call is running"

oneOf.description: A handle that names nothing — dropped, or never issued.
oneOf.title: The handle names nothing
oneOf.x-detail: "the handle names nothing: it was dropped, or never issued"

oneOf.description: Fossil's own fault, not the caller's. Nobody branches on it; a host shows it and reports it.
oneOf.title: An internal error
oneOf.x-detail: "internal error: {what}"

title: Problem
